title: Improve long-conversation context and follow-up retrieval
description: Extend the existing recent-turn context window with evidence-aware follow-up resolution and budgeted conversation compaction. Persist compaction/version provenance, retain complete original history and immutable paper/document bindings, and prevent repeated paid generation for the same request.
acceptance_criteria: Long conversations preserve useful prior facts/questions within the selected model budget.
Follow-ups retrieve evidence from the correct immutable document and explicitly report insufficient context.
Original messages remain available; compaction and generation settings are traceable.
UUID replay and interrupted-state protections continue to pass.
test_cases: Long multi-turn fixture with references to earlier questions and bounded context.
verification: Advanced history management was in the approved P2 plan; existing bounded recent-turn strategy remains operational.
